summary: Kuehne + Nagel is global logistics company based in Switzerland, founded in 1890. Type: listed company. About 76,000 employees (Wikidata). Revenue CHF 22 million (2017). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 1 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 3 about growth or hiring; 1 about legal trouble, strikes or bankruptcy.

insights.one_liner: Swiss global logistics giant with large Dutch operations and IND sponsorship; just signed a long-term logistics deal with Amazon.

culture.text: Very large: about 53,383 staff on LinkedIn; Wikidata gives 76,000 employees.
Most people studied logistics, business, international trade or economics and work in operations, sales and customer support.
Moves goods worldwide and handles storage, fulfilment and delivery around each shipment.

open.text: Kuehne + Nagel Logistics B.V. and Kuehne + Nagel N.V. are IND recognised sponsors.
Its open mid-level operations job at Schiphol does not require Dutch.

growth.text: Signed a long-term logistics deal with Amazon and AWS, including logistics for Amazon's data centre expansion.
Agreed an international framework deal with Jungheinrich for about 5,000 forklifts and warehouse trucks.
Opened a tech centre in Chennai as demand for digital logistics and AI tools grows.

worth_knowing.text: Its long-time owner Klaus-Michael Kühne died aged 89.
Will investigate its own role during the Nazi era.
Amazon could become a shareholder through the new partnership.
